svg.aria-label: How the team works with you, version 3: fourteen roles. Nine skills, the conductor among them, share your session context; five subagents run isolated, each receiving a task brief and returning one report, one at a time or in parallel according to the dispatch profile; every role carries an effort badge set by its task shape, and only you hold the switch that raises the session to max.
svg.title: Research-master team map v3: fourteen roles, nine skills and five subagents
svg.text: How the team works with you
Nine skills share your session; five subagents run isolated — and every role's effort is chosen by its task shape, never by how stuck it is.
role cards = the research-master plugin — replaced wholesale on update, never hand-edited
asks for max at an unbounded-judgement step
your project's facts — kept in your project; a plugin update never touches it

g.text: routes facts, audits memory vs git
premise audit of a decision before it is made
memoryless peer review of an anonymized bundle
the silent-bug gate — runs the whole suite
launches and babysits runs; writes ledger rows
git / GitHub with the never-push list
a role asking you to move the switch

text.tspan: No role hands work to another directly: every task brief leaves from you and the conductor, and every report
comes back to you. The nine skills share your whole conversation; each of the five subagents gets one brief and
returns one report — one at a time under the guarded profile, independent ones in parallel under open. Effort
is chosen by task shape up front; no role pins max — a role can only ask, and you raise the session effort, then lower it.

svg.text: follows task shape — closed verification xhigh · operations opus · xhigh · everything else inherits the session
